his_source_registration.sql: SELECT source_code,system_code,db_type,target_host,port,service_name,enabled,write_policy,updated_at FROM asset.asset_data_sources WHERE source_code='his_source_<his_host_id>' LIMIT 1

same_endpoint_sources.sql: SELECT source_code,system_code,target_host,port,service_name,enabled,write_policy FROM asset.asset_data_sources WHERE target_host='<his-host>' AND port=1521 ORDER BY source_code LIMIT 20

contract_view_catalog.sql: SELECT system_code,source_code,schema_name,table_name,column_count,updated_at FROM asset.asset_tables WHERE system_code IN ('HIS','HIS_SOURCE') AND table_name IN ('V_DRUG_TRACE_BILL','V_DRUG_TRACE_CODE') ORDER BY schema_name,table_name LIMIT 20
